scenario: 今天的基础设施赛道反复碰到同一件事：容量、草稿和预算都在移动时，怎样还能把训练和推理跑稳。生产分发可以只跟着容量拒绝走，而不先猜输出有多长；投机解码是不是真的更快，则取决于草稿训练、候选分配、隐层宽度和执行条件有没有被放在一起看。智能体已经能改自己的训练和推理栈，但局部变快不等于端到端收益。稀疏注意力的规划必须足够便宜，上下文也不必每步全读，前提是模型能判断此刻需要哪一块。小时电量约束下的公平，更不能只看总体吞吐；激活和梯度要能量化得更狠，位宽和通信也得按层保住精度。

papers.title: Cap-and-Track: Optimizing LLM Inference Request Dispatch Across Shifting Capacity
papers.authors: Benjamin Novotny, Doug Szeto, Chang Wang, Shicheng Chen, George Zhihua Yuan, Bob Kamma, Michael Ge, John Xin Zhou, Andrea Olgiati
papers.summary: 大模型推理如果按固定速率下发请求，机群扩缩和请求变长时，这个速率很快过时。生成长度在接入时还不知道，共享服务资源也可能突然变少。一套异步分发设计用拒绝信号跟踪当前接入上限：容量检查在饱和资源上快速拒绝，多余工作进持久优先队列，调度只凭这些拒绝向上试探或回退，不必预测输出长度，也不必重调集群速率。在生产环境同一流量的并行 A/B 中，该整形器少用 43% 的 H100 就跑完了一个分类器，但低优先级任务在回补高峰会等得更久。稳态容量的实引擎回放里，它的有效吞吐与一条调在实测容量之上的固定速率相差不到 1%。最忙的一天处理了 11 亿次请求。==分发可以只跟着容量拒绝走，而不必先猜输出有多长。==
papers.abstract: A fixed dispatch rate for LLM inference becomes stale as serving fleets resize and request sizes change. Generative output length is unknown at admission, and shared provider pools can lose capacity. We present Cap-and-Track, a design for asynchronous inference across provider capacity and internal GPUs. Meta's traffic shaper implements Cap-and-Track for post and live-video understanding. Refusals signal the backend's current admission ceiling. Durable priority queues hold excess work outside execution, including refused requests for retry. Cap is a fail-fast admission check at the saturated resource that refuses work before a long wait. Using only those refusals, the Track dispatcher probes upward and backs off. It follows the ceiling without output-length prediction or a fleet-level rate to retune. In a concurrent same-traffic production A/B, the shaper ran per-replica Cap plus Track. It served a classifier on 43% fewer H100s than its queued, fixed-rate precursor, though lower-priori
papers.score_note: Cap-and-Track：在容量变化下做 LLM 推理请求分发。Meta traffic shaper 已用于帖子与直播视频理解，是今日 infra 的工业系统论文。

papers.title: FACT: Fixed-Budget Allocation and Cross-Step Training for Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: Hadi Fares, Mayssa Hajj Hassan, Ali Salman, Ammar Mohanna
papers.summary: 投机解码让目标模型一次验证多个草稿 token，从而加快生成，但草稿预测更好、接受的续写更长，并不一定真的更快。一个实验框架在冻结的 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 上观察训练、候选分配和执行条件怎样一起决定接受率和延迟，把这三者放到同一套测量里。把预测特征的展开按更早的步骤加大权重来回传，接受率比均匀加权的分离训练提高 15% 到 24%。在固定预算、各层宽度匹配时，按置信度分配候选，相对自回归解码的加速在 HumanEval 上从 1.46 倍提高到 2.02 倍。可即便接受率不变，只改主机线程设置，也几乎能把加速抵消掉。==草稿训练和候选怎么分配，必须连同真实执行条件一起看。==
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates language-model generation by verifying multiple draft tokens in a single target-model pass. However, better draft predictions and longer accepted continuations do not necessarily produce faster generation. To examine this gap, we present FACT (Fixed-Budget Allocation and Cross-Step Training), an experimental framework for studying how drafter training, candidate allocation, and execution conditions jointly affect acceptance and latency. Using a lightweight feature-prediction drafter with a frozen Llama-3-8B-Instruct target under greedy decoding, we first examine how training translates into accepted tokens. Backpropagating through predicted-feature rollouts with greater weight on early steps improves acceptance by 15-24% over uniformly weighted detached training, yet average rollout proxy cross-entropy does not reliably rank drafters by acceptance. Beyond prediction quality, the placement of draft candidates also matters: with a fixed 256-node budget an
papers.score_note: FACT：固定预算分配与跨步训练的投机解码。

papers.title: RSIBench-Infra: Can Agents Optimize Their Own Training and Inference Infrastructure at Production Scale?
papers.authors: Hanlin Wu, Yifei Wang, Zhicheng Cai, Huan-ang Gao, Wei-Ying Ma, Ya-Qin Zhang, Jingjing Liu, Hao Zhou
papers.summary: 智能体若要自我改进，训练和推理基础设施的效率是很实际的一环，但现有基准多半只看内核之类的单层软件，能不能在生产负载下拿到端到端收益，仍不清楚。一套基准给出二十项训练和推理任务，覆盖不同模型族和模态，部署规模可达三十二张加速卡，起点是可运行的官方配方，智能体可以改引擎、内核和指令层，提交以镜像层固化，方便复现。独立评测在满足任务质量约束的前提下测量端到端表现。全部任务结果里，有 66.2% 超过了 1.10 倍、且经过验证的加速。当前智能体已经能改进生产规模的训练和推理性能，但找到有效策略、并把局部优化稳定转化成端到端收益，仍然不容易。==基础设施优化要看端到端，而不是只看某一层变快了。==
papers.abstract: Improving the efficiency of training and inference infrastructure is a practical component of recursive self-improvement. Existing benchmarks for agent-driven optimization largely focus on individual software layers such as kernel, leaving unclear whether agents can deliver end-to-end performance gains under production workloads. We introduce RSIBench-Infra, a benchmark of 20 training and inference tasks spanning diverse model families and modalities, with deployments of up to 32 accelerators on NVIDIA GPUs and Ascend NPUs. Agents start from runnable baselines derived from official recipes and can modify the software stack across engine, kernel, and instruction levels. An OCI image-layer submission protocol captures these changes for reproducible deployment, while independent evaluation measures end-to-end performance under task-specific quality constraints. Across all task results, 66.2% exceed $1.10\times$ validated speedup. These results demonstrate that current agents can improve p
papers.score_note: RSIBench-Infra：20 个训练/推理基础设施任务，检验 agent 能否在生产负载下优化自身 infra。

papers.title: LoopCache: Accelerating Long-Context Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers
papers.authors: Zizhuo Fu, Haochen Huang, Shengxuan Qiu, Linye Wei, Ziyu Tang, Runsheng Wang, Meng Li
papers.summary: 循环 Transformer 用权重共享的块反复执行，来用紧凑模型换来更大的有效深度，每一步都要维护各圈自己的 KV 缓存。现有的波动式自投机解码把草稿和目标 token 在一步里跨圈流水线化，但草稿只在固定圈更新，中间预测变了也不管，既会在过时轨迹上白算，又会在一步里装入多圈 KV，长上下文下访存被放大。一套方法按输出置信度在中间各圈动态改草稿，并用循环调度轮流使用各圈缓存，使每步 KV 访问落在单圈，同时给少数对圈敏感的浅层保留独立缓存。实验里，它相对 WaveFront Decoding 和 LoopSpec 的平均加速分别为 10.25 倍和 14.56 倍。==长上下文里的自投机，要把草稿更新和 KV 访问都限制在当下真正需要的那一圈。==
papers.abstract: Looped Transformers achieve large effective depth with compact models by repeatedly applying a weight-shared block across R recurrent steps, each maintaining a loop-specific key-value (KV) cache. To accelerate sequential loop execution, recent wave-style self-speculative methods like WaveFront Decoding (WFD) and LoopSpec pipeline draft and target tokens across loops in a single step. However, they face two critical limitations. First, they draft only at fixed loops and ignore intermediate prediction changes, wasting computation on stale trajectories. Second, batching tokens from different loops loads up to Rx the KV cache per step, severely amplifying memory traffic in long-context scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose LoopCache, an efficient self-speculative decoding framework for long-context Looped Transformers. Based on the correlation between prediction switches and output confidence, LoopCache introduces confidence-guided dynamic draft updating to refine drafts in fl
papers.score_note: LoopCache：加速 Looped Transformer 的长上下文自投机解码，服务侧 KV/解码优化。

papers.title: NarrowSpec: Draft Hidden Width Need Not Match the Target in Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: Alagappan Valliappan, Ankit More, Dheevatsa Mudigere, Jatin Mitra
papers.summary: 投机解码里，小草稿模型先提议 token，再由目标模型一次验证。读取目标隐状态的草稿模型，通常会把隐层宽度也设成和目标一样宽。研究表明，草稿整段残差流可以跑在目标一半甚至四分之一的宽度上，而接受率大体仍能保住；对借用目标词表投影的一类草稿，训练好的输出适配还能折进该投影，更窄的投影在舍入误差内不改变对数概率。在单请求、温度为零时，把草稿变窄，在 GB10 上端到端解码可加速 1.13 到 1.44 倍，在 B200 上也同样更快。更大批次下两端加速最高达到 1.21 倍，没有一种变窄草稿比全宽更慢。==草稿不必为了对齐目标，就把隐层也撑得一样宽。==
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding is widely used to speed up generation in large language models (LLMs), with a small draft model proposing tokens that one forward pass of the target model verifies. Draft models that read the target's hidden states, such as DFlash and EAGLE-3, typically inherit the target's hidden width. We show that the draft's whole residual stream can run at half or a quarter of that width while largely preserving acceptance. For DFlash, which borrows the target's vocabulary projection, the trained output adapter folds into it, giving one narrower projection with logits unchanged up to floating-point rounding. We test two drafter families, DFlash and EAGLE-3, on two targets, Qwen3-8B (NVFP4) and GPT-OSS-20B (MXFP4), in SGLang on a B200 and a DGX Spark (GB10). At batch size 1 and temperature 0, narrowing the draft to half or a quarter width speeds up end-to-end decoding by 1.06-1.12x on B200 and 1.13-1.44x on GB10. The speedup holds at larger batch sizes. From batch 32 to the lar
papers.score_note: NarrowSpec：投机解码中 draft 隐层宽度不必对齐 target。

papers.title: DexAttention: Distributed Sparse Attention through Rapid Online Planning and Persistent GPU Execution
papers.summary: 稀疏注意力能减少计算，但分布式执行仍可能传输多余数据，并在每次操作上付出不小的开销。按掩码来分配和调度可以降低这些成本，前提是动态掩码的重新规划，必须比它省下的执行时间更便宜。一套系统把快速在线规划和持续执行放在一起设计：分配器在 GPU 上做感知拓扑的聚类，以平衡计算并减少通信；轻量调度排出粗粒度的通信和计算顺序，各卡上的常驻内核再落实细粒度依赖、派发已就绪的任务。在十六卡集群、十一种配置上，相对当时适用的最快基线，端到端训练的几何平均加速为 1.39 倍；对动态视频注意力，把规划算在内，相对环形注意力可加速 2.11 到 2.37 倍。==分布式稀疏注意力的规划本身，必须快到规划得起。==
papers.abstract: Sparse attention reduces computation, but distributed execution may still transfer unnecessary data and incur substantial per-operation overhead. Mask-aware assignment and scheduling can reduce these costs, but replanning for dynamic masks must be cheaper than the execution time it saves. We present DexAttention, a distributed sparse attention system that co-designs fast online planning with persistent execution. Its assigner uses GPU-accelerated, topology-aware clustering to balance computational load and reduce communication. A lightweight greedy scheduler orders coarse communication and computation operations, while a persistent kernel on each GPU enforces fine-grained dependencies and dispatches ready tasks. This division keeps detailed synchronization out of planning while enabling overlap without repeated attention launches. The framework supports static and dynamic per-head masks across multiple attention compute kernels. On a four-node, 16-GPU cluster, DexAttention achieves a $
papers.score_note: DexAttention：分布式稀疏注意力与持续 GPU 执行。

papers.title: MoE-Context: Show the Model Only What It Needs
papers.summary: 智能体每走一步，常常把整段历史重新读一遍，人和这样做不同：当下需要的留下，其余先当成可以再取回的简短笔记，并不删掉。一套方法把上下文切成块，每一步先用一次快速的是否判断，决定这一步需要哪些块，其余块保留为一行笔记，随时可以召回。作者实现的版本由同一个模型做决定并作答，共用一套 KV 缓存，被隐藏的块是被掩住而不是被删除。在笔记本上用 Qwen3-1.7B 做合成查找任务时，只展示需要的块，准确率从 120 题中的 93 题提高到 119 题；被掩住的块和被删掉的块一样看不见。模型自己挑选仍是弱项，简单的关键词检索在该任务上反而能全部选对。==上下文不必每步都全读，但先要能判断此刻真正需要哪一段。==
papers.abstract: AI agents read their whole history at every step. People do not work like that: we keep what the moment needs and hold the rest as a rough note we can recall. MoE-Context applies this to language models. The context is split into blocks. Before each step a fast yes or no pass decides which blocks the step needs; the rest stay as one-line notes that can be brought back, and nothing is deleted. In the version we build, one model makes this decision and then answers, over a single key-value cache where hidden blocks are masked rather than removed. On a laptop with Qwen3-1.7B and a synthetic lookup task, showing only the needed block raises accuracy from 93 to 119 of 120, and a masked block is as hidden as a deleted one. The model's own picking is the weak part. A supervised linear probe written into spare output rows lifts its accuracy from 80 to 110 of 120, but simple keyword search picks perfectly on this task, and the probe does not transfer to a second task. We report these results op
papers.score_note: MoE-Context：只向模型展示需要的上下文，MoE/serving 相关。

papers.title: Vanguard: Knowing When to Trust the Draft in Speculative Vision-Language Agents
papers.authors: Hanqi Mao, Jiajun Fan, Ruihan Guo, Shuaike Shen, Ziwen Wang, Hui Ren, Xianrui Zhong, Ge Liu
papers.summary: 浏览网页、操作手机或在家里行动的视觉语言智能体，每一步都要先推理再行动，也在等大模型，延迟和成本都会挡住部署。步骤级投机让小模型先起草每一步，只有草稿被拒绝时才叫大模型，但结局取决于裁判；只看步骤文本的裁判，判断不了这一步是否贴合眼前的屏幕。一套无需再训练的裁判在看得到截图的情况下，一次前向就给候选步骤打出正确概率，超过阈值就采用，否则才由大模型来写。在 Mind2Web 的一个测试集上，2B 草稿经该裁判筛选后，步骤成功率为 66.5%，高于单独使用 8B 目标模型的 64.4%。在另一测试集上为 66.8%，对照为 63.3%。大模型只写了少数步骤，闭环回合也完成得更多。==步骤级投机的关键，是裁判要能对着屏幕判断草稿该不该信。==
papers.abstract: Vision-language agents that browse websites, operate phones and act in homes reason before every action, so every step waits for a large model, a latency and cost that stand in the way of deployment. Step-level speculation lets a small model draft each step and calls the large model only on rejected drafts, but its outcome rests on the judge, and a judge that reads only a step's text cannot tell whether the step fits the screen it acts on. We find that a few samples of a small model can contain a correct step about as often as the large model gets the step right, and not always on the same steps: checked against the screen, small drafts can be not only cheaper but better. We present Vanguard, a training-free judge that leaves the draft and target models unchanged: a general decision model, with the screenshot in view, gives each candidate step a probability of being right in one forward pass; the best candidate is kept if it clears a threshold, and otherwise the large model writes the
papers.score_note: 快速通道：标题命中赛道锚点，按核心中等分；未进全文精评。

papers.title: eFAIR: Fair LLM Serving under Hourly Electricity Commitments
papers.authors: You Peng, Youhe Jiang, Chen Wang, Binhang Yuan
papers.summary: 数据中心可在日前市场按小时承诺购电，大模型服务若在这些小时预算里运行，只把总体吞吐做高，仍可能让个别请求一直等，或远慢于期望。公平服务既要改善最差请求的体验，又得给稍后到来、时间和用量未知的请求留出电量。文章用归一化吞吐来比较请求：把实际输出速率除以单独服务吞吐与服务权益的乘积，并在小时电量约束下优先照顾这一比率最低的请求。调度把请求分发、电量预算和 GPU 频率选择对准同一个归一化吞吐目标。在各有三十二个副本的 H20 与 H200 配置上，相对最好的仍满足预算的基线，归一化吞吐的第十百分位提高 28.0% 到 31.0%，对小时电量承诺的绝对偏差低于 0.26%。==小时电量约束下，公平不能只看总体吞吐。==
papers.abstract: Datacenters can procure electricity in day-ahead markets by committing to energy purchases for individual hours. For LLM services operating within these hourly budgets, maximizing aggregate throughput alone may still leave individual requests waiting or receiving much slower service than desired. Fair serving therefore requires improving service for poorly served requests while reserving electricity for later arrivals whose timing and demand are unknown. To compare service across requests, we define normalized throughput as each request's actual output rate divided by the product of its standalone throughput and its service entitlement, a positive weight representing its desired service level. Using this measure, we formulate fair serving as leximin optimization under an hourly electricity constraint, prioritizing requests with the lowest normalized throughput. To address this problem, we present eFAIR, an online scheduler that coordinates request dispatching, electricity budget alloca
papers.score_note: eFAIR：小时级电力约束下的公平 LLM serving。

papers.title: AGoQ: Activation and Gradient Quantization for Memory-Efficient Distributed Training of LLMs
papers.authors: WenXiang Lin, Juntao Huang, LuHan Zhang, Laiyi Li, Xiang Bao, mengyang zhang, Bing Wang, Shaohuai Shi
papers.summary: 量化是降低大模型训练显存的常用办法，但现有方法在接近四比特的激活和八比特梯度上往往很难用，容易收敛变慢或精度受损。一套方法按层类型和流水线阶段为激活分配位宽，使激活存储接近四比特，同时用八比特存储梯度，并做尽量保精度的八比特 All-Reduce，以缩短通信时间。在两套最多六十四张 GPU 的集群上，用 8B 到 32B 的 LLaMA 模型，相对 Megatron-LM、COAT 和 DeepSpeed 等现有训练系统，显存最多降低 52%，训练速度最多提高到 1.34 倍，预训练损失能够收敛，下游任务精度也可与之相比。==激活和梯度要能量化得更狠，位宽就得按层来分，通信也得在低位宽上保住精度。==
papers.abstract: Quantization is a key method for reducing the GPU memory requirement of training large language models (LLMs). Yet, current approaches are ineffective for 4-bit activations and 8-bit gradients, which would easily cause slow convergence or accuracy loss. To address this, we introduce AGoQ, incorporating two new techniques: 1) a layer-aware activation quantization algorithm that allocates appropriate bit-widths for activations of various layers based on their types and pipeline stages to achieve near 4-bit activation storage, and 2) a gradient quantization algorithm that reduces memory usage and shortens communication time by employing 8-bit gradient storage and precision-preserving 8-bit All-Reduce communication. We conduct extensive experiments using different sizes of LLMs on two GPU clusters (up to 64 GPUs), and the experimental results show that our AGoQ reduces the memory by up to 52\% and achieves up to 1.34$\times$ improvement of training speed compared to state-of-the-art traini
papers.score_note: 快速通道：标题命中赛道锚点，按核心中等分；未进全文精评。
